description: Tell the story of our forgotten space equipments
summary:
Project name is 'Moon Pioneers: The Story of NASA's Lunar Explorers'.  
We created a storyline about NASA’s previous moon missions and how it enabled the upcoming missions, that is understandable and engaging to students and non-space enthusiasts. 
Storyline:   A small kid interested in the Moon, learns the challenges in travelling to and landing on the Moon from her Mom.  They make a visit to NASA space center and learn the different Moon programs in the past – Rangers, Surveyors, Apollo missions and how they formed a base for the upcoming missions.  The facts are minimal and presented in easily digestible format.
The project is developed using scratch tool and output recorded as a video for presentation.
details:
Project is an engaging storyline of NASA's previous missions that includes useful facts presented in an engaging manner using basic animation. Intention of the project to educate people of NASA's Moon missions, the challenges encountered and high-level plans they have in the future.

Tools used: NASA's public resources, Copilot, Scratch, Paint, Windows Word, Notes, Miro Board, PowerPoint

We used creative ideas in identifying an engaging storyline, use of NASA's rovers as characters, different presentation format.

Factors considered for the project - shortlisted ideas that can be implemented in short duration, Keep the storyline simple and complete, but expandable later to include more facts, visual improvements, updates with this prototype as a base.
